data.name: Kaleelah
data.gender_notes: Kaleelah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'kall' which means 'friend' and 'illa' which means 'Allah'. The name Kaleelah means 'Friend of Allah'. The name Kaleelah carries the meaning “Friend of Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Kaleelah usually hope their child will grow to embody friend of allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies a deep spiritual connection to Allah and a reminder of the importance of being a true friend and companion to Him.
data.etymology: Kaleelah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friend of Allah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kaleelah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
